description: Pre-archimedean (symbolic, formal q) derivation of the explicit 3-term recursion for the Taylor coefficients of the Markov parameter z(q)=√q/(1+q) around q=1: 4(n+1)a_{n+1} + 6n·a_n + (2n−1)a_{n−1} = 0, from the ODE (4+6w+2w²)z'+wz=0. This is the recursion↔q-difference identity. Coefficients are EXACT rationals, extend to all orders with no q_0 / no CODATA fitting. τ_M(T_β) = A(q)+B(q)·z(q) inherits this structure (z² ∈ ℚ(q)).
